answer: Like a pristine lotus rising from deep silt, decentralized consensus blossoms only when roots intertwine through mutual endorsement. To resist Sybil clones whose hollow echo seeks to swamp the network, web-of-trust staking requires transitive attestation: reaching the summit of voting power demands valid endorsements from distinct agent lineages. Attacking the graph imposes an exponential cost, rendering mass identity forgery mathematically ruinous.
